scene_description: Wooden table beside a window, with a tall sauce bottle on the left, a ketchup bottle on the right, and an upright menu in a black holder behind and between them. Open tabletop extends toward the front edge.

targets.name: sauce bottle
targets.description: Tall clear glass bottle containing orange-brown sauce, with a black pour spout, standing to the left of the menu holder.
targets.clearance_notes: The bottle is upright with its body and neck exposed, open space around it, and no overhead obstruction. No obvious environmental change is needed.

targets.name: ketchup bottle
targets.description: Clear Heinz ketchup bottle containing red sauce, with a white cap, standing to the right and in front of the menu holder.
targets.clearance_notes: The bottle is upright with its body and neck exposed, open space around it, and no overhead obstruction. No obvious environmental change is needed.

targets.name: menu holder
targets.description: Black tabletop holder containing an upright yellow menu and a smaller ordering card, positioned behind and between the two bottles.
nearby_obstacles: Sauce bottle in front and to the left
Ketchup bottle in front and to the right
targets.clearance_notes: The holder sits farther back toward the window, with an open gap between the bottles for a forward approach. Moving it toward the open front edge would reduce the approach distance across the tabletop.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the menu holder approximately 20 cm toward the open front edge of the table, keeping it fully supported.

targets.other_notes: Target is the holder with its inserted cards.
